### Investigating Jesus
Author: Andrea Chatelain
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wholly-loved/investigating-jesus-wholly-loved-september-15.html
Passage: John 1:39
Points:
- Our deep longing to be known and connected finds its fulfillment in Jesus.
- Jesus never hides, ignores us, or forces us to chase after Him.
- He intentionally stops to meet us and extends an invitation to come and see.
- Just like the first disciples, we are welcomed into unhurried, authentic fellowship with Him.
- In prayer, we can bring Him our questions, celebrate sweet moments, and rest in His care.

### Bringing Others to Jesus
Author: In Touch Ministries
Site: In Touch Ministries
URL: https://www.intouch.org/read/daily-devotions/bringing-others-to-jesus
Passage: John 1:35-42
Points:
- Andrew recognized the value of knowing Jesus and immediately brought his brother Simon to Him.
- Asking where Jesus was staying showed a desire to spend time learning in His presence.
- Closeness with Christ should overflow into sharing the joy of salvation with others.
- Although personal styles and daily circumstances differ, every believer is called to point others to Christ.
